outcome: Population doubling time of Wharton's Jelly (WJ) mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (MSCs)
Genome-wide DNA methylation of WJ MSCs
cohort: 14 umbilical cords from healthy non-obese (n = 7) and obese (n = 7) donors undergoing elective Cesarean section
finding: WJ MSCs from obese donors showed slower population doubling, stronger immunosuppressive activity, and altered DNA methylation, particularly in the PNPLA7 gene, compared to WJ MSCs from non-obese donors.
